caption: The drawing depicts a full-length, ornate gown with a fitted bodice and wide, flared skirt. The gown is beige or light cream in color and features an intricate floral pattern with various colors including green, red, pink, blue, and yellow. The dress has ruffled trim along the neckline, front opening, and sleeve edges, and the sleeves are elbow-length with additional ruffles at the cuffs. There is no visible head or feet, as the focus is solely on the dress. To the upper right of the main colored drawing, there is a smaller, monochrome line sketch of the dress shown from the back, which displays the same wide skirt and the gathered detail at the sleeves. The background of the drawing is a plain, light tan color.
title: Wedding Dress
